notes.title: Maze Odyssey is 60% off
notes.content:
[p]Hey!  [/p][p]I’m the solo dev behind [b]Maze Odyssey[/b], and… well, the launch has been humbling.[/p][p]In the past month:[/p][p]- 3 people bought the game  [/p][p]- 2 of them haven't even launched it  [/p][p]- The demo has a [b]median playtime of 4 minutes[/b][/p][p]Apparently the pixel mazes and cryptic mind-melting traps were *not* what the world was waiting for.[/p][p]But maybe… you’re different?
[/p][p]🌀 [b]Maze Odyssey is 60% off[/b] right now, and the [b]free demo[/b] is still live.  [/p][p]You’ll know within 5 minutes if this game is your kind of weird.
[/p][p]If you’re into mazes that glitch, secrets that whisper, and getting slightly uncomfortable without knowing why — this game is for you.
[/p][p]And if not? That’s okay. I made this game because I needed to.  [/p][p](But I wouldn’t mind if someone actually finished it.)[/p][p]Thanks for being here.  [/p][p]– Developer, still lost in the maze[/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Reduced price for Maze Odyssey
notes.content: [p]Maze Odyssey now costs 4,99 euros. A reduce from its start price of 7.48 euros.  A demo has also been released and attached to the store page. [/p][p]Hope some one will check it out![/p]

notes.title: Maze odyssey out now! 40% Launch Discount!
notes.content:
[p]My game, Maze Odyssey has finally been released on Steam to this date: 19th of June 2025. You can find it on this page:  
[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3781150/Maze_Odyssey/"][/dynamiclink]
The game is a new take on the Maze genre, where I try to combine elements from Bomberman ganes with recurring elements seen in games like Banjo Kazooie! It has taken me six years to create and finish, so I am happy to finally have it live!   [/p][p]Thanks to the 15 people who wishlisted the game as well as all the testers, who tested the game up to its release date.   25% of the sales will be donated directly to humanitarian relief in Gaza through red cross Denmark.[/p]
